Only these pure functions run; no OpenCode agent, subagent, shell or permission-ask runtime is enabled.
Lower the select loop-local const next to var for Rhino block-binding semantics; the pinned algorithm and comparisons are unchanged.

Reuse upstream exact, line-trimmed, indentation-flexible and boundary-trimmed replacements, uniqueness checks and disproportionate-span rejection. Disable fuzzy/escape matching; normalize line endings at the Java boundary. Use split/join for literal replaceAll semantics and var loop locals for Rhino. No upstream filesystem or LSP service is enabled.
